3899-4659-5003-6644.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

275-5078-7356.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

413-3249-5111-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

969-1368-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
969-1368-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2103-2556-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and exiling Ephemerate.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7328-7356.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7328-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

3259-4742-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

57-969-3094-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-969-3094-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1322-3490-3755-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1322-3490-3755-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

413-1579-6972--112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Visionary Augmenter ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-1579-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-5361.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Auton Soldier.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Auton Soldier by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1671-5451-5702-6763.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-5451-5702-6763.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

104-3641-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3641-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1021-4050-4693-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-4050-4693-6761.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {1}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-4050-4693-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

771-1980-2276-6229-6668.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Said // Done or Sorceress's Schemes must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
771-1980-2276-6229-6668.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Said // Done without paying its mana cost, targeting Sorceress's Schemes.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Said // Done, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Said // Dones, causing you to return Sorceress's Schemes and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Sorceress's Schemes without paying its mana cost, targeting Said // Done.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Sorceress's Schemes, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Sorceress's Schemess, causing you to return Said // Done and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

880-4488-5478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4488-5478.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2080-4050-4823.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
2080-4050-4823.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Timeless Witness, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1170-4659-5131--58.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4659-5131--58.description:
Cast the artifact that can be cast using {C}{C} from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact cast in step 1, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
1170-4659-5131--58.notes: If the artifact can be cast using {C} or less, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

215-2757-3661-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest.
215-2757-3661-5705.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Shield Sphere, untapping the Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the Forest.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Shield Sphere from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If desired, once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite {C}, and then you may forego tapping or sacrificing them on future iterations to get infinite creature tokens.

1339-1692-2034-5185.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to The Locust God.
1339-1692-2034-5185.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of The Locust God.
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God and the Locust God token each trigger twice, creating a total of four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

467-549-1978-2092-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
467-549-1978-2092-4659.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

1794-4050-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
1794-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper, adding one mana of any color.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

1283-1545-4078-4242-5231.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1283-1545-4078-4242-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {R}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

2992-4050-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Living Lightning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Living Lightning, adding {B}.
When Living Lightning dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2645-3430-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three mana-producing lands.
2645-3430-4657.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {9}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping three lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1376-1379-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1376-1379-1978.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat

uses.n: Cyclonus, the Saboteur // Cyclonus, Cybertronian Fighter

3750-3898.notablePrerequisites:
Cyclonus has power 5 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Permanents you control can tap to produce at least {6}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
An opponent cannot block Cyclonus.
3750-3898.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Cyclonus, the Saboteur.
Cyclonus triggers, causing it to connive and convert it to Cyclonus, Cybertronian Fighter.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent using Cyclonus, Cybertronian Fighter.
Cyclonus triggers, causing you to convert it to Cyclonus, the Saboteur and to get an additional beginning phase after this one.
Move to your beginning phase, causing you to untap all permanents you control.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat.

4619-5138.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other black creatures.
4619-5138.description:
Cast Mind Bend by paying {U}, changing all instances of "white" on Teysa to "black".
Activate Teysa by sacrificing three black creatures, targeting any creature.
The creatures die, triggering Teysa three times, creating three 1/1 black Spirit creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

292-4498-4831.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to add {B}.
You have the highest life total.
292-4498-4831.description:
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Cacophodon and Rite of Passage trigger.
Resolve the Rite of Passage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Cacophodon trigger, untapping the permanent that can produce {B}.
Repeat.
